_what: Every outside skill Athena ships: source, the pinned commit, and the record of reading it end to end (ATH-10). Copies are unchanged apart from a `model:` frontmatter line and the patches named. swaps: Blueprint name -> installed skill.

office-hours.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Six forcing questions, premise challenge, alternatives, design doc; no code. Codex second opinion and mockups need gstack's runtime (absent in the cloud; off on the Mac). Output feeds the Scope form.

plan-ceo-review.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Scope review in four modes; expansion-biased, so Athena runs it in HOLD SCOPE or REDUCTION. Exit gate needs gstack's review log (Mac). Patched: frontmatter hook and bin/ removed.

plan-eng-review.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Locks architecture, data flow, failure modes and a test diagram; never builds. Exit gate needs gstack's review log (Mac); Codex outside voice disabled without the runtime.

design-consultation.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Interview, then writes DESIGN.md (design system). Image previews and Codex voice need the runtime; falls back to an HTML preview. Defers to Athena's DESIGN standard.

design-shotgun.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Mockup variants from gstack's design binary, which calls OpenAI's image API with your key; inert without it. Mac only, on Nimish's request.

design-review.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Visual audit of built screens (about 80 checks, A-F score). Needs gstack's browser (Mac). Its fix loop commits code: Athena runs it report-only into specs/<ID>/ui/.

review.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Pre-landing diff review: checklist, specialists, adversarial pass. Many steps need gstack's helpers and skip without them; auto-fix is off under Athena (report only). Codex voice disabled without the runtime.

qa.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Browser and API QA with a fix loop and health score. Needs gstack's browser (Mac). Athena: report-only into specs/<ID>/ui/, no test-bootstrap writes to CI or CLAUDE.md.

cso.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Security audit (secrets, deps, CI, OWASP, STRIDE). Needs gstack's cso launcher and Docker; without them it reports 'not assessed'. Sends no source or findings.

canary.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Post-deploy browser watch of a live URL, baseline compare. Needs gstack's browser (Mac); refuses a curl fallback. Never rolls back without Nimish.

learn.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Shows, searches and prunes learnings kept in ~/.gstack through gstack's scripts (Mac). The repository's playbook.md is written by athena-learn.

grill-with-docs.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Runs grilling plus domain-modeling: rounds of numbered questions with recommended answers, then glossary and decisions. No network.

grilling.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Dependency of grill-with-docs: asks the open questions in rounds until understanding is shared. No network.

codebase-design.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Vocabulary for deep modules, seams and adapters; optional design-it-twice with parallel agents. No network.

domain-modeling.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Keeps a glossary and sparse decision records during design talks. No network. Decisions go to docs/decisions/ under Athena.

to-spec.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Turns the conversation into a PRD-style issue. It labels ready-for-agent; under Athena it files a Scope-form draft for Nimish, never scope-locked (guard refuses it).

to-tickets.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Cuts a plan into thin vertical slices in blocker order, publishes after approval. Under Athena: GitHub issues, Scope form, spec-ID titles, never scope-locked.

tdd.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). One test, then the code that passes it; no horizontal test batches; mocks only at boundaries. Unattended, the seams come from the locked proofs. No network.

diagnosing-bugs.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Build a red feedback loop first, then hypotheses, tagged logs, regression test, cleanup. Redacts secrets. Local script template only.

retro.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Retrospective on a session from local logs; suggests improvements, edits nothing. Run per milestone. Never edits the managed CLAUDE.md.

writing-for-agents.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Dependency of retro: how to write instructions agents follow. Text only.

frontend-design.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). UI design guidance, text only, Apache-2.0. Athena's DESIGN standard and shadcn/ui win on conflict.

find-skills.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Searches skills.sh via the skills CLI. The CLI's telemetry is on by default: off through DO_NOT_TRACK; guard allows only `npx skills@1.7.6 find` (no installs).

subagent-driven-development.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Fresh implementer and reviewer per task. Harness copy of v7.0.0, superpowers: prefixes removed; Athena's block rule beats its 'rulings, not stalls'.

using-git-worktrees.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Detects or makes a worktree, installs deps, runs a baseline test. Identical to upstream. Commit .gitignore on the feature branch only.

writing-plans.reviewed: read end to end 7 Nov 2026 (ATH-10). Bite-sized test-first plans with self-review. Prefix-only change; Athena adds the [capability:] rule; the plan path is specs/<ID>/plan.md. ATH-23: model line changed from opus to sonnet (plans are written at build time; kind `build`).

swap_reasons.investigate: gstack retired /investigate on 7 Nov 2026 (GST-1717): its own evaluation found no gain over no skill. Pocock's diagnosing-bugs is already the Debug stage's primary.
